name: Lightweight Desktop + Chrome
postCreateCommand: wget -q https://dl.google.com/linux/direct/google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ./google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb && rm -f google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb && echo 'alias chrome="google-chrome --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage"' >> /home/vscode/.bashrc
